interpretive_limits_fixed_in_advance: The ordering is an ENHANCEMENT (+22.66%), not a PRECONDITION: T2 alone already scores +38.11% over nothing. A ratchet found here means 'the later gain is worth more on the foundation', NOT 'impossible without it'. The disposition must say so.
Detection floor 12.3% lift; ratchets smaller than that are INVISIBLE to this instrument. A NULL must be read as 'no ratchet above the floor', never as 'no ratchet'.
Ordering claims require gains >= 20% (ordering_bar_pct) because near-floor gains are MISLOCATED, and temporal ordering is condition 1 of the ratchet definition.
